title: Extern's Corporate Strategy Externship teaches the Incorruptible framework
summary: Extern runs a four-week Corporate Strategy Externship with Eric as mentor, in which participants read proxy statements and score real companies on mission drift, financial gravity and governance. Eight have written publicly about it since July, from a Morehouse undergraduate to a senior vehicle engineer.
attribution_title: Corporate Strategy Externship · four weeks · mentored by Eric Ries
blockquote: My focus was Ben & Jerry’s, where I initially rated its governance too generously. The ongoing dispute surrounding its independent board highlighted an important lesson: safeguards only work when backed by genuine authority and independence.
blockquote_source: Dinojan Wiky, who placed in the top 10%, on LinkedIn
